fields.name: binStep
docs: Bin step. Represent the price increment / decrement.

fields.name: baseFactor
docs: Used for base fee calculation. base_fee_rate = base_factor * bin_step * 10 * 10^base_fee_power_factor

fields.name: filterPeriod
docs: Filter period determine high frequency trading time window.

fields.name: decayPeriod
docs: Decay period determine when the volatile fee start decay / decrease.

fields.name: reductionFactor
docs: Reduction factor controls the volatile fee rate decrement rate.

fields.name: variableFeeControl
docs: Used to scale the variable fee component depending on the dynamic of the market

fields.name: maxVolatilityAccumulator
docs: Maximum number of bin crossed can be accumulated. Used to cap volatile fee rate.
